summary.en: RSF drone strikes have intensified, targeting Sudan's power system in the east and causing widespread outages, while the Sudanese army has shot down an FH-95 drone over West Kordofan. Sudan has filed formal complaints against Ethiopia at the UN Security Council and the African Union over cross-border drone attacks. Displaced civilians returning to Khartoum and Darfur face new challenges, including famine risk in Kalma camp and survivors pledging to document killings after recent camp attacks. The conflict resulted in 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF-militsens dronstråler har økt, og retter seg mot Sudans kraftsystem i øst og forårsaker omfattende strømbrudd, mens den sudanske hæren har skutt ned en FH-95-drone over Vest Kordofan. Sudan har innlevert formelle klager mot Etiopia i FNs sikkerhetsråd og Den afrikanske unionen over grenseoverskridende dronavianfall. Fordrevne sivile som vender tilbake til Khartoum og Darfur møter nye utfordringer, blant annet sultfare i Kalma-leiren og overlevende som lover å dokumentere drap etter de siste leirangrepene. Ifølge UCDP førte konflikten til 4 680 drepte i kamper i 2024.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
